relations: The tall left-edge flame varies in height and lean while its base stays anchored to the object's left edge.
The front flame alternates between a continuous band and broken tongues that reshape and rejoin over the charred surface.
Stray embers drift at upper left while the burning object holds its position and overall shape on the dirt.
Pebbles, the gray ash pile, and pale paper debris remain stationary as the flames flicker continuously.
caption: The video captures a tan, rounded object resting on sandy dirt, its front-left face already blackened and alight. A tall yellow-orange flame rises from the object's left edge while a lower, wavering line of fire traces the top of the charred front, the two burning regions flickering continuously as occasional stray embers drift at the upper left. The tall flame shifts in height and lean, at times standing upright, at times bending sharply left into a thin tongue that seems to detach near the upper-left corner before drawing back. The front flame alternates between a near-continuous band and broken, separated tongues that reshape and rejoin. The object itself holds its position and overall shape against the ground, the darkened patch persisting without obvious collapse. Scattered pebbles, a pile of gray ash to the right, and pale paper debris to the left remain stationary on the ground.
